note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The initial and the additional claim are supplied values of this example, shown with equal weight: nothing states a rule for an additional claim (admissibility, connection, set-off, time limits) or any effect, and neither claim cancels, defeats or reduces the other. A and B differ only in whether an additional claim is supplied; the initial claim is identical and stays in place in both.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long labels, capped (item 20): long party names, case-file title and claim titles; scenario labels, changed fact, shared fact, guide and neutral note longer than the baseline's. The cap's driver: every shared text is printed in the strip under (or beside) the two scenes, and at full length the strip leaves the scenes too short for the 45 px stress head floor.
